experiment_data.hypothesis: Training the K=1 MultiScaleCRM architecture on OpenVLA's multi-scale Llama-7B features (4 layers × 4096-d, action_dim=6 single-step) will provide a learned conformal correction module for OpenVLA on LIBERO-Object, with the goal of improving over the OpenVLA VLA-only baseline (SR=69%). This differs from the prior train-crm-openvla-obs-only (K=10 obs-only architecture, eval SR=0%) by using the multi-scale attention fusion + action-conditioned gating from plan_700.
